name: A Lesson in Literacy
summary: A librarian believes you are ready to write your own spellbook. Gather a quill, ink, and papyrus for its pages.

sections.title: Spellbook Materials
sections.body: A librarian sees promise in your arcane studies and asks you to gather supplies for a spellbook. The requested materials are an owlbeast quill from the Hinterlands, ink made from silithid resin, and Farraki Papyrus for the pages.

faq.q: What does the librarian want me to collect?
faq.answer: The librarian asks you to collect an owlbeast quill from the Hinterlands, ink derived from silithid resin, and Farraki Papyrus.

faq.q: Why am I gathering these materials?
faq.answer: The librarian thinks you are ready to write a spellbook of your own.

faq.q: Where does the quill come from?
faq.answer: The librarian asks for a quill from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: What is the ink made from?
faq.answer: The requested ink is derived from silithid resin.

faq.q: What are the spellbook pages made of?
faq.answer: The librarian requests Farraki Papyrus for the pages.
